name: Custom Shape Pen and Pencil Holder Stand
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:

Made from high-quality wood with a thickness of 5mm, ensuring durability and a natural aesthetic appeal.

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Available in two size options:

 - 13 x 13 cm ~ 5.12 x 5.12 inches

 - 20 x 20 cm ~ 7.87 x 7.87 inches

The main panel is made from a single 5mm thick wood layer, precision-cut into a custom shape, depending on your design.

The base part consists of two layers of wood, with a total thickness of 1 cm, providing excellent stability.

Ring Pencil Holder 1 & 2 Diameter: Approx. 0.5 cm ~ 0.2 inches

All connection slots are precision-cut to approx. 0.48 cm ~ 0.19 inches for a seamless and secure fit.

  • Printing Technology:

Designed using advanced UV printing technology, delivering sharp, vibrant, and fade-resistant images.

Printed on both sides, ensuring it looks great from any angle on your desk.

  • Functionality & Usage:

Combines practical use with decorative appeal — perfect for holding pencils or pens in style.

Ideal for organizing writing tools while adding a decorative touch to your workspace.

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:

A versatile and heartwarming gift suitable for teachers, students, friends, or colleagues.

Ideal for any occasion such as Teacher’s Day, Graduation, Birthdays, Christmas, or New Year.

Personalization makes it a memorable keepsake that shows genuine appreciation.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
